about_the_game:
Mayoi Shoutengai is a first-person horror game where you must escape from a terrifying shopping district.

The protagonist is you.

Once it begins, there’s no turning back.

Story:

This is the fourth entry in the Nestbound Series, where scattered tales converge into one.

The stage is Mayoi Shoutengai, a mysterious shopping district located on Kannagi Island.

A girl named Satsuki Kuon, trapped in Mayoi Shoutengai, awakens to find no way out.

Together with Shiki, who is also trapped, she searches for an escape from the endless maze of storefronts.

“We have to get out of here soon… I have a really bad feeling…”

Can Satsuki and Shiki escape the horrors of Mayoi Shoutengai?

Note: Although part of the Nestbound Series, each title can be enjoyed as a standalone experience!

Features:

Horror Presentation
Unexplainable phenomena occur throughout the Lost Shopping Street.
Experience a brand-new kind of fear like never before.

Rich Text Content
The more you read, the deeper the story gets!?
Includes stories that connect with both past and future titles.

Time Attack Mode
Break all the seams and escape as fast as you can!
Compete with other players for the fastest clear time in the rankings!

Multiple Endings
Three different endings await.

Gamepad Supported

Estimated Playtime
Around 1 hour

Additional Notes
This title includes Supporter Content, which can be toggled on or off from the title screen.

About Streaming and Content Creation
All games by Actor may be streamed or shared without needing prior permission.
We would love for more people to discover and enjoy our games,
so if possible, we’d greatly appreciate it if you could mention the store page when posting or streaming! (Of course, this is entirely optional.)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+ x64
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel Intel or AMD
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K or AMD
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
